Emergency assistance application designed for safety and quick response.

ResQTap is an emergency application designed to help users send emergency alerts, share live location, and communicate quickly during emergency situations. The app aims to improve user safety through fast emergency response features.
ResQTap values user privacy and applies reasonable security measures to protect user information and emergency data.
Version 1.0\nDeveloped using Android Studio\nPowered by Firebase

ResQTap Terms & Conditions
Welcome to ResQTap. By downloading, installing, accessing, or using this app, you agree to be bound by the Terms & Conditions below. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please stop using the app immediately.
1. Introduction
ResQTap is an emergency app designed to help users send emergency alerts, share their current location, and connect with contacts or room members during emergency situations. This app is intended to improve user safety but does not replace official emergency services such as police, hospitals, fire & rescue, or government authorities.
2. User Eligibility
By using this app, you confirm that:
You are at least 13 years old, or you use the app under guardian supervision. You have the right and authority to accept these terms. All information provided during registration is true, accurate, and up to date.
3. App Usage
You agree to use ResQTap only for lawful purposes. You must not:
Use the app for fraud, harassment, threats, or illegal activities. Send false SOS alerts intentionally. Misuse location features or other users’ data sharing. Hack, modify, reverse engineer, or attempt to gain unauthorized access to the app?s systems. Use the app to distribute harmful content, viruses, spam, or activities that may impact other users.
ResQTap reserves the right to suspend or terminate user accounts if these terms are violated.
4. SOS & Location Sharing
This app may use:
Real-time GPS location Internet connection Notifications Device vibration Selected contact access Room/member data
You understand that:
Location accuracy depends on your GPS and internet connection. SOS delivery may be disrupted due to network issues, battery limitations, system failures, or factors beyond control. ResQTap does not guarantee 100% successful emergency alert delivery at all times.
5. User Responsibility
You are fully responsible for:
Your account security. Keeping your login information confidential. All activities performed through your account. Ensuring your device has working internet and GPS.
You also agree not to misuse the emergency system in a way that causes panic, disturbance, or harm to others.
6. Privacy & User Data
ResQTap may collect certain user data including:
User name Profile information Current location Emergency data Room/member information App usage logs
This data is used for:
App safety features Emergency alert delivery System improvement Analytics and app stability
We take reasonable steps to protect user data, but you understand that no digital system can be guaranteed 100% secure.
7. Limitation of Liability
ResQTap is provided "as is" and "as available". We do not guarantee that:
The app will always be free from bugs or interruptions. All notifications will be received on time. The system will work without network disruptions or technical failures.
The ResQTap developers are not responsible for:
Data loss Device damage Injury Loss of life Direct or indirect losses Failure to deliver SOS due to external factors
Use of this app is at your own risk.
8. System Changes & Updates
We reserve the right to:
Change app features Add or remove functionality Update the system Change design or policies Suspend or discontinue services temporarily or permanently without prior notice
9. Intellectual Property
All content in the app including:
The ResQTap name Logo Design Source code Graphics User interface
is owned by the developer or the rightful owner and protected by copyright laws.
Users may not copy, sell, distribute, or exploit any part of the app without written permission.
10. Termination
We may suspend or terminate access without notice if:
There is a violation of these terms The system is misused Suspicious activity is detected There is a threat to the security of the app or other users
11. Third-Party Links & Services
The app may use third-party services such as:
Google Maps Firebase Notification systems Location APIs
Use of these services is subject to their respective terms and policies.
12. User Consent
By using ResQTap, you confirm that you:
Have read and understood these Terms & Conditions. Agree to comply with the rules stated. Understand the risks of using digital, internet-based emergency systems.
13. Contact Us
If you have questions, suggestions, or reports related to ResQTap, please contact the developer through the app?s official support channels.
